details: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $731 million in net inflows on September 3, marking their largest single-day intake since January. This surge in institutional interest helped propel Bitcoin's price back above $80,000, signaling renewed demand and contributing to the recent market rally.
title: Bitcoin Surges as ETFs See Biggest Inflows Since January

details: Standard Chartered announced on September 3 that it has launched cryptocurrency spot trading for Bitcoin and Ethereum for institutional clients in the United Arab Emirates. This move makes it the first global systemically important bank to offer such a service in the Gulf country, expanding its digital asset offerings for eligible institutional clients.
title: Standard Chartered Launches Institutional Spot Crypto Trading in UAE

details: Despite Bitcoin's recent rally above $80,000, analysts at Fidelity Digital Assets warn that the bear market may not be over. They suggest that while recent performance offers optimism, it doesn't confirm an end to the bear cycle, noting that Bitcoin could still see a potential low around November 2026 based on historical four-year market cycles.
title: Fidelity Cautions Bear Market May Not Be Over Despite Bitcoin Rally

details: Ethereum's upcoming "Glamsterdam" upgrade has entered its final development phase, with mainnet activation aimed for the second half of 2026. This significant hard fork is designed to enhance Layer 1 scaling, improve block building efficiency, and introduce gas repricing to potentially cut transaction fees.
title: Ethereum's "Glamsterdam" Upgrade Enters Final Development Stage

details: Ethereum developers have proposed a major redesign of validator deposits to prepare staking for the quantum-computing era. This draft aims to support quantum-resistant signing keys and eventually phase out current BLS cryptography, protecting the tens of millions of ETH currently staked from future quantum attacks.
title: Ethereum Developers Propose Quantum-Resistant Validator Deposits

details: Interstice Digital, in partnership with FalconX, has launched a cross-chain swap engine connecting the Canton Network with Ethereum, Solana, and Robinhood Chain. This non-custodial engine facilitates the movement of liquidity and tokenized assets between institutional-grade markets and major public blockchains, promoting greater interoperability.
title: FalconX and Interstice Launch Cross-Chain Swap Engine for Canton Network

details: XRP's spot trading volume climbed to its highest level since February during August, and the token's price jumped approximately 8% in the last day, trading near $1.45. This pickup in activity coincided with a broader crypto market recovery, with Bitcoin clearing $80,000.
title: XRP Trading Activity Jumps, Price Gains Amid Broader Market Recovery

details: Zcash (ZEC) surged over 21% in the last 24 hours, with its price breaking past $1,000 for the first time in eight years. This rapid ascent triggered a significant short squeeze, reportedly causing one trader to lose over $18.5 million on their ZEC short position.
title: Zcash (ZEC) Explodes Over 21% as Trader Faces $18M Short Squeeze
